args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

The `handleClick` function in the `ExportButton` component only resets the `busy` state to `false` when the `exportReport` promise resolves successfully. If the export fails (e.g., due to a non-2xx HTTP response), the `busy` state remains `true`, disabling the button. To fix this, the `catch` block of the `exportReport` promise should also set `busy` to `false` to re-enable the button after a failure.
